# telnyx_address_accept_suggestions (Action)

Accepts the suggested corrections to an address, so it can be used for emergency services and Operator Connect.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address_id` (String) The address id.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the address.
